name: null-accounts
description: GitHub and GitLab account manager for Null IDE — multiple identities, per-project binding, and a token API for other Null IDE features

null-accounts.gitlab.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth application ID (device flow, public client) used to sign in to **gitlab.com**.

null-accounts.gitlab.hostClientIds.markdownDescription: OAuth application ID per self-hosted GitLab host, e.g. `{ "git.example.org": "abc123" }`. Register the application on that instance as a non-confidential app with the scopes `read_user api write_repository`.

commands.title: Null Accounts: Switch Account for This Project
Null Accounts: Use Account for This Project
